content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham's Amritapuri Campus is described on its website as a multi-disciplinary research and teaching institute, located in the village of Vallikavu. The post is listed under the Teaching job category.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Other requirements printed in the notice: Minimum three first-author publications in Scopus-indexed Q1 journals and five additional publications in Scopus-indexed Q1 or Q2 journals. Strong hands-on experience in research methodology, statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, and computational research. Proficiency in relevant statistical, analytical, and computational research tools. Demonstrated ability to independently develop research proposals, analyze and interpret data, and prepare scientific manuscripts. Excellent academic writing, teaching, and communication skills. Desirable: postdoctoral experience, experience in securing external research funding, patents, and international research collaborations. Prior specialization in yoga is not mandatory. Candidates from scientific, technical and interdisciplinary backgrounds with a keen interest in advancing research in yoga and contemplative sciences are encouraged to apply. Candidates should check the official job page for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment will be under the University's Research Track, with teaching responsibilities. Teaching includes Amrita Yoga courses, following structured training and competency assessment. The notice does not print the pay, the contract term or the allowances.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conceptualize, design, and undertake independent and collaborative interdisciplinary research. Develop competitive research proposals and pursue national and international research funding opportunities. Conduct quantitative research, statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, and computational research. Apply data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning methodologies to yoga, health, and well-being research, where appropriate. Conduct systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and bibliometric studies. Prepare and publish high-quality research papers in Scopus and Web of Science-indexed journals, with an emphasis on Q1 and Q2 publications. Develop interdisciplinary research collaborations within Amrita and with national and international institutions. Contribute to research innovation, patents, copyrights, and intellectual property development, where applicable. Undertake academic teaching, including Amrita Yoga courses, following structured training and competency assessment. Guide and mentor students and supervise or co-supervise PhD scholars, subject to university eligibility criteria.
